operation_details.item: The user is allergic to dust mites and experiences flare-ups during hotel stays while traveling for sales.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good morning! I noticed you have client visits booked across several cities next week. How are you preparing for the trip?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: It's a big week for relationships. I'm focused on showing up sharp for each client, even though the hotel hopping can be rough on my allergies. I am allergic to dust mites, which often flares up when I stay in hotels during frequent client travel.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Thank you for sharing that. I won't try to diagnose anything, but I can suggest some practical ways to reduce triggers while you're on the road. Have you tried requesting allergen-free hotel rooms when booking?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Sometimes, but I don't always remember to ask, and availability varies from hotel to hotel. What else tends to help?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Carrying hypoallergenic pillow covers can be a great backup, and keeping your clinician's allergy management plan handy will help you stay consistent with your usual approach during the trip.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That's a good reminder. I usually pack my own pillowcase anyway, so a full hypoallergenic cover would be even better. I'll add it to my packing list.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Also, when you check in, asking for a room that has been cleaned thoroughly and has no carpet can make a big difference. Would you like to draft a short message to send to each hotel ahead of time?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That would help. I want to keep it polite but specific so they can prepare before I arrive.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Great. Here's an example: "Due to dust mite allergies, could my room please be allergen-free, with no carpet and extra HEPA cleaning? I'll also bring my own hypoallergenic pillow cover." Does that capture what you need?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: It does. I'll send that to each hotel today and pack the pillow covers tonight. Following my clinician's plan should keep me at my best for the client meetings.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Sounds like a solid plan. If you need any adjustments after the first stay, we can refine it before the next city. Safe travels.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Thanks. I appreciate the practical support.
